item.title: Gunmen kill two SPLM delegates and leave several missing in an attack between Mundri East and Mundri West, South Sudan
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Mundri, Western Equatoria, South Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians, Abduction & hostage-taking. Alleged perpetrator: Unidentified gunmen. Reported casualties: 2 killed. Disputed or caveats: Single outlet (Sudans Post); fate of missing unclear. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0659
